Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in

Class FinancialApi

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.FinancialApi
@Service public class FinancialApi extends Object
Bridges legacy financial endpoints to wallet use cases and compatibility services.
